title: Navidrome desktop functional acceptance
scope: Navidrome source defines music-client functionality. MixRadio is a separate component/layout/visual/design reference. Native web administration APIs and Windows Phone UI are separate scopes.

scoreAnchors.3: All stated criteria hold at the declared evidence layer.
scoreAnchors.4: The criteria also hold in independently observed alternate states and repeated runs.

cases.title: Locked source and complete endpoint accounting
steps: Run the named production checks from a clean commit and inspect the scoped proof groups.
expected: The pinned clean Navidrome commit/remote/source bytes match the lock.
Every registered endpoint is mapped to a function, a documented legacy alternative, a fixed compatibility response or an explicit upstream unavailable status.

Skip/change account during a delayed response.

Absent/failed/stale results do not invent recommendations.
prerequisites: A configured acoustic provider with known similar songs and a provider-absent configuration.
